verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms GitHub serves an llms.txt at docs.github.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured header describing GitHub Docs, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The evidence only shows that the file exists, not how much it covers or what other agent-oriented formats are offered. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt content depth and coverage, per-page markdown or llms-full.txt variants, first-party documentation of the agent-docs offering, independent corroboration.
